tasks.analysis: Future progress of the current education system in America is dependent on the implementation of an early education program. As research has demonstrated, there are tremendous gaps between the school readiness of children from various social economic backgrounds. In order for all children to be prepared for kindergarten, there must be a universal accessibility to a proper policy driven early childhood education system.
